create_TodStructuredRound: create a TodStructuredRound dataclass instance with user utterance, API call, API response, and system utterance fields
create_TodStructuredEpisode: create a TodStructuredEpisode dataclass instance with API schemas, goal calls, and a list of dialogue rounds
use_SerializationHelpers_api_dict_to_str: use SerializationHelpers to convert an API call or response dictionary into a semicolon-separated string utterance
use_SerializationHelpers_str_to_api_dict: use SerializationHelpers to parse a semicolon-separated API utterance string back into a dictionary of slot values
use_SerializationHelpers_delex: use SerializationHelpers to delexicalize text by replacing slot values with bracketed slot names
